status: Expanded reactive round 2 completed 2026-10-29: 40 paired 24-40 second neural rollouts, native swept collision response, 36x14m course and ten pillars. Duck/vault extensions remain future work.
goal: More natural humanoid motion through reactive navigation, acceleration and K0-Tech pursuit; preserve selected takes as game animation assets.
architecture: Application reads obstacle and target state
Planner chooses route, desired speed, facing and interaction targets
MotionBricks generates toward 1-4 target poses using the latest four actually displayed context poses at 30 Hz
Collision/contact layer validates or corrects displayed poses; corrected displayed poses feed subsequent context
Recorder stores native motion, displayed retarget, actor trajectories and generation trace

boundaries.obstacles: Current model has no scene-geometry input. Scene boxes trigger authored smart primitives; they are not neural collision geometry. Planner and collision checks are application responsibilities.
boundaries.speed: Use matching locomotion targets and controlled desired velocity; measure actual travel rather than increasing playback speed.
boundaries.pursuit: A seeded moving cat can supply a moving goal. Pursuit prediction, stop distance and replanning are application logic.
boundaries.quadrupeds: Official released model contracts are SOMA human and Unitree G1 humanoid. No ready-made K0-Tech quadruped model was found. Cat should initially use its own authored gait/actions and procedural navigation.
boundaries.naturalness: Compare existing G1 with the SOMA human model using permitted original/CC0/user-owned targets; better naturalness is a hypothesis to measure.

proposed_trials.task: Idle to walk to run through a marked straight section, brake before a boundary
proposed_trials.comparison: Abrupt target change versus bounded acceleration and braking

proposed_trials.task: Follow K0-Tech around seeded random waypoints; stop outside its personal space
proposed_trials.comparison: Aim at current location versus short-horizon predicted interception

proposed_trials.task: Combine pursuit, pillars, narrow passages, jump/duck triggers and an arrival idle
proposed_trials.comparison: Fixed recorded choreography versus target updates driven by actual displayed state

trial_design.seed_policy: Fixed environment/cat seeds for paired comparisons; record generation settings and seeds separately.
trial_design.speeds: Begin near each target gait native speed, then sweep speed/turn rate/target horizon to find failure boundaries.
trial_design.collision_check: Root navigation capsule plus conservative body/limb proxies; optionally dense skinned-geometry checks offline. Do not label root-only clearance as whole-body collision freedom.
trial_design.review: Reuse Keep/Rework/Reject and timestamped notes with clip and retarget versions.

recording_plan.native: G1 qpos or SOMA local transforms, timestamps and predicted contacts
recording_plan.displayed: Bake the actual corrected C08 skeleton and root trajectory, not unused predicted futures. Preserve uncorrected native data separately.
formats: FBX export for engines that need it
JSON targets, events, seeds, licenses, versions and review references
variants: In-place take with separate root trajectory
recording_plan.workflow: Generate or steer a take, record, scrub/mark in-out, review, keep, bake/export, check engine import and loop/contact quality. Offline baked clips do not require shipping inference with a game.

community_examples.name: MotionForge
community_examples.evidence: Creator guide documents MotionBricks G1/SOMA steering, per-character takes, target pose arrival, Bake/Discard and retargeting.
community_examples.relevance: Closest documented artist workflow for generating and keeping game clips.
community_examples.caveat: Documentation reviewed, addon not installed or independently validated. Guide requires Blender 5.0 for SOMA human, 5.2 for G1; our existing Blender is 4.5.15.

community_examples.name: LocalAI motion-bricks.cpp
community_examples.evidence: Primary README and repository document end-to-end G1 GGML CPU/Vulkan inference, C ABI, server-owned browser streaming and planning/advance APIs.
community_examples.relevance: Potential later portable runtime or game-engine bridge.
community_examples.caveat: No complete Unreal plugin verified in this repository; no performance measured on this PC. Existing NVIDIA runtime remains our baseline.

community_examples.name: motionbricks-mlx
community_examples.evidence: Primary README documents Apple Silicon planning, batch baking and A-to-B motion switching with quality gates.
community_examples.relevance: Useful ideas for per-take manifests, paired controls and seam measurement.
community_examples.caveat: README states no checkpoint published, pretrained NVIDIA weights not used, and training scaffold only exercised on synthetic shards. Do not treat its reported results as a verified substitute for the official model.

quadruped_alternative.project: AI4Animation / Mode-Adaptive Neural Networks for Quadruped Motion Control
quadruped_alternative.note: Separate quadruped research, not MotionBricks; repository explicitly limits use to research/education and mocap is CC BY-NC 4.0. No asset copied or installed.

recommendation: First build reactive pursuit plus obstacle waypoints and speed zones on the existing local GPU runtime, record real generated takes, then compare SOMA and G1. Keep K0 authored initially. Evaluate MotionForge in an isolated newer Blender installation only if its documented workflow merits the extra dependencies.

execution.mixed_scope: Pursuit, pillars and speed zone; no duck/vault generation in this initial round.
